How does home window security film protect your home? Find the answer below along with the other benefits of having your home windows tinted. Tint a Home offers high-quality security film for house windows that are government certified by ARPANSA and is exclusive to us (supplied from the largest supplier of window film in the world). With over 42 years of experience providing tinting services, we are home window tinting experts and Australia’s most trusted window tinting network. If you’re considering having security film for house windows installed here are some of the benefits:

Benefits of Security Film For House Windows

In addition to making your home safer, security film for house windows also:

  • Helps to protect you and your family from the harmful effects of UV rays
  • Protecting your flooring and furnishings from fading
  • Increases privacy (reflective films that turn your windows into a mirror mean those on the outside can’t see in)
  • Doesn’t have to alter the appearance of your home if a lighter film shade is used

We also offer a lifetime warranty on all residential applications and have interest free payment options available through Zip Pay.

How Does Security Film For House Windows Work?

Because home window security film is 10 x thicker and 7 x stronger than the standard film it adds a layer of protection that deters intrusion into your home. If your windows are hit with force, security film for house windows will help to keep shattered glass in place, slowing entry into your home. This also means your home is safer for your family if the glass is broken accidentally or if there is severe weather.
